newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices firm, supplies tight.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices firm, supplies tight.

text.p: Millfeed prices were firm and unchanged in most locations as support from tight supplies was balanced by light demand as spring pastures lessen the need for supplemental feeding, millfeed dealers said.
In St Louis, where flour mills have cut weekly operations to four days or less, millfeed offers rose $4.00 per ton. Elsewhere prices were mostly unchanged.
Chattanooga sources said flour business was so poor some flour mills took the unusual action of shutting down Tuesday or Wednesday versus weekend closures.
Catfish on farms in Mississippi were becoming more active and required more feed. But catfish were less active further north where cool overnight weather inhibited their movement, dealers said.
